scaling.scope: Identical 512 ceiling/escape queries, 121 roof panels. First batch includes startup; four fresh-revision warm batches. Not game FPS or a cross-machine benchmark.

environment: M1 Pro, headless Chrome, 1440x900, approximately 60 Hz, Vite, live weather. Not RTX; not a fixed-world causal A/B.
scope: Existing saved 1000-part three-storey fixture, camera orbit at multiple heights. Not a new artistic socket build. Three ignition seeds, then deliberate mass ignition. Rendering remains native by default; primitive run is only an adapter.
simulation: Support/roof rules, damage, fire, smoke and collapse ON. Animals, construction surface snow and thermal fields OFF. Ground/tree snow and weather ON. Simulation may progress slower than wall time under overload; phase names do not prove a settled pile.
workers: Shared hardwareConcurrency - 2 active-job budget, minimum 1. Support, geometry and exact room/vent queries have real workers, lazy mirrors and memory/work-size bounds. No SharedArrayBuffer requirement. Smoke transport/fire decisions remain 2 Hz on the main thread, damage 1 Hz; visual motion remains frame-rate driven.
